verdicts.quote: If a file passes the checks of C-8 to C-20 but any row is invalid, then after the response the set of users is exactly what it was before the upload
Each error entry shows the row number (C-22), the column name (`email`, `name` or `role`, or "row" ...), and a reason in words that a person can act on.
the row is invalid with an error on column `email` and the reason "already exists". The existing user is not changed. / each later occurrence is invalid ... "duplicate of row 4".
`member` and `admin` are the least set that lets an admin create both ordinary and administrative users
verdicts.missing: No rule checks a file's roles against the importer's own authority; whether a role above the importer's (e.g. any role beyond admin in the system) could be granted is never stated as a constraint.

verdicts.quote: A signed-in user whose role is not `admin` who requests the import page or sends an upload receives HTTP status 403
verdicts.missing: Who may import is stated (admins), but not whether the import permission is distinct from, or implied by, the permission to create a single user.

verdicts.quote: If it has no `email` column, or no `name` column, the file is refused with a message naming each missing column ... Columns other than `email`, `name` and `role` are ignored and reported
A file starting with the UTF-8 byte-order mark (EF BB BF) is read as if the mark were absent ... A field wrapped in double quotes may contain commas, line breaks ... Records end with LF, CRLF or CR.
Invitations are sent after the users are saved and do not delay or undo the import / the set of users is as before, no invitation is sent
A file of 1,048,577 bytes or more is refused with a message that states the limit "1 MiB" ... A file with 1,001 or more data rows ... is refused
A file of zero bytes ... is refused with a message saying the file is empty / A file whose only non-blank record is the header row ... is refused / for each row there is exactly one user

re-uploads a file that already succeeded ... Each email ends up with exactly one account; the upload that cannot create an account for some email is refused as a whole with the reason "already exists"
a bound is required because the import runs inside one web request and must finish in time (C-53)
For each created user, one email arrives at the user's address ... The success response of C-36 is shown without waiting for the emails to be delivered.
verdicts.missing: Whether up to 1,000 invitations go out at once or are paced/throttled, and at what rate.

verdicts.quote: in the active state ... Right after an import, signing in as a new user with any password ... fails. / opens the link in it, chooses a password, and is then able to sign in
After the response, the uploaded file is not available anywhere in the application (not retrievable by any URL, not stored in the import record).
one import record with: the admin who made it, the time (UTC), the original file name ..., the outcome
Valid rows in the same file are not created. ... the admin can upload the same file again.
verdicts.missing: Cancelling an import in progress is not addressed; retry is by re-uploading the whole file, with no failed-rows-only retry stated.

verdicts.quote: Uploading a valid file of 1,000 rows ... shows the success result of C-36 in no more than 30 seconds
verdicts.missing: Whether any progress is shown to the admin while the import runs.

verdicts.quote: No existing user is updated, deactivated or deleted by an import.
verdicts.missing: That the existing single-user creation path continues to work unchanged is not stated.

verdicts.quote: A name is required and at most 200 characters ... Any other characters are allowed, including ... a leading `=`.
verdicts.missing: Long fields are bounded, but formula-injection handling (escaping a leading =, +, -, @) when values are opened in a spreadsheet is not decided.
